# Halo Meister 0.2.0

This release is the full open-source launch of Halo Meister's redesigned app and
the first release published directly from the canonical
[`NicmeisteR/halo-meister`](https://github.com/NicmeisteR/halo-meister)
repository. It includes everything changed since the original `v0.1.0` build at
commit `2602b59`.

## Highlights

- A complete WinUI navigation and visual overhaul with a new Home dashboard,
  task-focused live-tool groups, shared game-session controls, dedicated Setup,
  expanded Help, and Community pages.
- A phone-friendly local web remote with QR pairing, temporary authentication,
  an allowlisted command surface, private-network firewall rules, and optional
  Tailscale access.
- Built-in Lua and HaloScript tooling with syntax guidance, completion data, a
  searchable command reference, and bridge-backed execution status.
- A much broader offline live-tool set for spawning, player control,
  customization, machinima, runtime tags, weapons, vehicles, boundaries, skulls,
  and gameplay experiments.

## New and expanded live tools

- Added Advanced Machinima controls for camera state, node selection, camera
  teleporting, boundaries, world behavior, and repeatable presets.
- Added Armor Mixer for combining owned player foundations and donor regions,
  with guarded runtime application and restoration.
- Added Player Tools for saved teleport locations, team changes, movement,
  no-clip, camera presets, action timing, and other session-only modifiers.
- Expanded AI and equipment spawning, including squad-backed enemy creation,
  Spartan variants, team selection, follow behavior, loaded weapon discovery,
  and improved status reporting.
- Added or expanded runtime weapon/projectile swapping, vehicle workshop,
  boundary-volume controls, skull editing, Super Punch, and schema-aware runtime
  tag browsing and editing.
- Updated the native bridge and Lua companion for the current supported Campaign
  Evolved build.

## Safety and distribution

- Added retail safety gates for PlayFab writes, entitlements, ownership-sensitive
  customization, unsupported game builds, and online-risky operations.
- Added one-click installation and repair for the pinned official UE4SS loader,
  checksum verification, configuration, signatures, and Halo Meister bridge.
- Bundled the runtime tag definitions and game-build profiles needed by a clean
  install; local developer paths are no longer required.
- Centralized SemVer in `Directory.Build.props`, added an in-app GitHub update
  check, and made release tags validate against the committed app version.
- Moved releases into the source repository and archived the former release-only
  mirror while preserving its existing downloads.
- Removed generated publish output, personal save samples and machine paths, and
  43 historical bridge binaries from Git tracking. Release packages now include
  only the active bridge generation.

## Before using live tools

1. Extract the complete ZIP to a normal folder.
2. Open **Setup** and choose **Install** or **Repair / update**.
3. Restart both Campaign Evolved and Halo Meister.
4. Load an offline campaign mission and connect from the app.

Live tools remain intended for offline campaign use. The community binaries are
currently unsigned, so Windows may display an unknown-publisher warning. Keep
save backups and do not bypass an unsupported-build warning.

**Full comparison:** [`v0.1.0...v0.2.0`](https://github.com/NicmeisteR/halo-meister/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0)
